Body.Content:
Save time entering information into Business Central with Auto paste. Building on Autofill, Auto paste uses AI to identify relevant information from text or HTML copied to your clipboard and map it to the appropriate fields on a Business Central page.

Benefits

Reduce manual data entry when bringing information from external sources into Business Central.

Populate multiple relevant fields from copied content instead of copying and pasting individual values.

Extend AI-assisted data entry to more everyday Business Central workflows.

GA date: April CY2027

Preview date: December CY2026
